1.consolidated_definition: Disimular: ocultar o minimizar algo, especialmente un defecto o una verdad incómoda, para evitar conflicto o crítica.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To conceal or downplay something, especially a defect or an uncomfortable truth, in order to avoid conflict or criticism.

reference_definitions: prnl. Calmarse. Tranquilizarse. Retirarse de actividades peligrosas.
